source: University of Dhaka Statistics B.S. Honours 2023–24, Stat H-101 and related Stat H-109 practical topics

topics: Statistical questions, populations, samples, variables, descriptive versus inferential scope, random selection and summation
Measurement scales, data sources, dictionaries, missingness and cleaning
Classification, frequency, cumulative tables, grouped approximations and cross-tabulation
Bars, pies, histograms, dot/stem displays, time plots, scatter plots, ECDF, QQ plots and box plots
Arithmetic, geometric and harmonic means, median, mode, quantiles and weighting
Range, quartile deviation, absolute deviation, variance, standard deviation, CV and standardization
Raw/central moments, skewness conventions, Bowley asymmetry, raw/excess kurtosis
Pearson, Spearman, Kendall tau-b and W, point-biserial, biserial, phi, tetrachoric, eta and ICC
Simple least squares, residuals, sums of squares, reverse regression and integrated practical analysis
